name: reserve
description: Stocks of resources that fill and empty: fuel, mana, oxygen, ammunition, wood and stone, the strength that keeps a body alive. Each kind of resource is an item of the game's resource list, kept by one Reserve; what costs, what gives and what the things of the world hold is said by the other components. The ge/mod/reserve/stock.hpp header lets other modules spend and give.

components.name: Reserve
components.description: The stock of one kind of resource (an item of the game's resource list; the oldest Reserve of a kind is the one used): amount, at most max. It loses drain every second by itself (a body that needs it to live, a fire that burns its wood) and never goes below floor through a drain or a cost (a place where the stock is spared: costs that would go below it are refused). When amount reaches 0, the action empty_action (none by default) is pressed once. The module keeps gained (everything it was given, through a Gain or another module: what was gathered, for a rule) and fill, amount divided by max (0 to 1), for a gauge, a picture or a rule. A transform2d.Disabled Reserve does not drain by itself.

components.name: Drain
components.description: While the entity is not transform2d.Disabled, takes from the Reserve of kind per_second every second, plus per_unit for every unit of the number field names ("transform2d.Velocity.x", without its sign) on this same entity: walking that tires, an engine that burns more the faster it goes.

components.name: Gain
components.description: Every tick, gives the Reserve of kind per_unit for every unit of the number field names on this same entity (without its sign): a count of what was gathered this tick ("terrain2d.Digger.last", the cells dug) becomes a resource.

components.name: Yield
components.description: What the entity holds, for whatever gathers it (another module): amount of the resource kind. A tree holds wood, a rock stone, a body its strength.

systems.name: flow
systems.description: Gives what every Gain brings, takes what every Reserve and Drain uses, keeps each amount between its floor and its max, updates fill, and presses the empty_action of a Reserve that has just run out.
